'''Hakuzo''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is a member of the Seventh Circle Fiends.

==In-Game Appearance==
As an NPC character, Hakuzo first appears briefly in Raid Class 7: Dichroma Chaos but plays a bigger role in Grand Quest - The Echoing Void.
